name: Fideal
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fideal is a figure from the folklore of Scotland. This Highland water spirit led attractive young men toward lakes and ponds, where she drowned them. She counts as a kind of Vough.

attributes.attribute: lured young men into lakes and drowned them

okr.objective: Fideal is a Scottish water siren and a species of the Vough.
key_results: A Highland siren who lured handsome young men into lakes and ponds.
Classed as a species of the Vough.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
